analysis: The method is an implementation of InvocationHandler.invoke, used in dynamic proxies for PipelineOptions. It handles a fixed set of known methods (toString, equals, hashCode, outputRuntimeOptions, as, populateDisplayData) and then maps method names to property getters/setters. If the invoked method does not match any of these patterns, it throws a RuntimeException. This indicates a programming error or misuse, as the proxy only supports a specific set of methods. The throw is a defensive fail-fast mechanism, not intended for normal error recovery.
remark: The RuntimeException is thrown when an unknown method is invoked on the proxy. This scenario indicates a programming mistake (e.g., calling a method not supported by the proxy interface). The programmer intended this exception to propagate uncaught as a signal of a bug, rather than being handled by the caller in normal operation.
